summary.en: Community local LLM inference engine and chat app built natively for Windows 11 on Arm64 with RTX Spark.
summary.zh-TW: 社群開發的本機 LLM 推論引擎與聊天應用程式，原生支援 Windows 11 Arm64 與 RTX Spark。

caveats.en: Self-reported by one developer in the repository README; no independent test and I did not run it or confirm a published release file.
caveats.zh-TW: 僅為單一開發者在 README 的自述；未經獨立測試，我也未執行或確認已發布的安裝檔。

caveats.en: Early version 0.1.0; the repository states it targets the RTX Spark (GB10, sm_121) GPU only.
caveats.zh-TW: 早期版本 0.1.0；儲存庫說明僅針對 RTX Spark（GB10、sm_121）GPU。

evidence.title: Sparkle README: native win-arm64 Setup and zip, benchmarks measured on RTX Spark N1X
